_comment: Attaches the browser preview to the dev stack; it starts nothing itself, so run `make up` first. `port` and `url` must match the port this checkout publishes — 80 by default, or HTTP_PORT when .env.local overrides it, as a worktree sharing the machine has to. A stale value here does not fail loudly, it previews a different stack. Keep it http://: the dev stack serves plain HTTP, see compose.override.yaml.
